<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications
This PR adds 3 complete test suites targeting the Ascend NPU platform, covering parameter effectiveness verification and functional validation. All test cases follow the existing test framework conventions and CI specifications, maintaining consistency with the current codebase.
1. **Linear Attention & ReplaySSM Parameter Validation Test**
    - Target parameters: `--linear-attn-verify-backend flashinfer`, `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec`
    - Validates whether the parameters take effect by checking characteristic startup log markers
    - Reuses standard server lifecycle management, health check and temporary log capture utilities
    - Registered to `full-2-npu-a3` nightly pipeline

2. **Legacy SMG gRPC Server Mode Test**
    - Target parameter: `--smg-grpc-mode` (legacy SMG gRPC server)
    - Verifies full startup flow through 7 gRPC readiness log markers + actual TCP port listening check
    - Implements real-time log tee output for in-place debugging
    - Registered to `full-1-npu-a3` nightly pipeline

3. **PD Disaggregation Decode Extra Slots Validation Test**
    - Target parameter: `--disaggregation-decode-extra-slots`
    - Verifies that extra slots correctly increase `c128_state_fixed` memory allocation in the DSV4 memory pool
    - Implements two-round comparison test (baseline vs extra_slots=64) with full process cleanup and resource release between rounds
    - Inherits from `PDDisaggregationServerBase` and follows the standard disaggregation test structure
    - Registered to `full-16-npu-a3` nightly pipeline

+"""Test --smg-grpc-mode parameter on NPU.
+Verifies that the SMG gRPC server starts correctly and serves requests.
+Logs are printed to screen in real-time (tee) while also captured for assertions.
+"""
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+import time
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import QWEN3_0_6B_WEIGHTS_PATH
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=400, suite="full-1-npu-a3", nightly=True)
+
+# The SMG gRPC servicer listens on server_args.port. The server is launched
+# without --port, so it uses the sglang default port.
+GRPC_PORT = 30000
+
+# Essential readiness markers for a successful SMG gRPC startup
+_GRPC_READY_MARKERS = [
+    "gRPC server listening on",
+    "The server is fired up and ready to roll!",
+]
+
+
+def _tee_output(pipe, log_file):
+    """Read from pipe, print to screen, and write to log_file."""
+    for line in iter(pipe.readline, ""):
+        sys.stdout.write(line)
+        sys.stdout.flush()
+        log_file.write(line)
+        log_file.flush()
+
+
+class TestNpuSmgGrpcMode(CustomTestCase):
+    """Testcase: --smg-grpc-mode starts the SMG gRPC server on NPU.
+
+    [Test Category] Parameter
+    [Test Target] --smg-grpc-mode
+    """
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = QWEN3_0_6B_WEIGHTS_PATH
+        cls.grpc_port = GRPC_PORT
+
+        command = [
+            "sglang",
+            "serve",
+            "--model-path",
+            cls.model,
+            "--tokenizer-path",
+            cls.model,
+            "--device",
+            "npu",
+            "--trust-remote-code",
+            "--log-requests-level",
+            "2",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.85",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "ascend",
+            "--disable-cuda-graph",
+            "--dtype",
+            "bfloat16",
+            "--disable-radix-cache",
+            "--enable-metrics",
+            "--smg-grpc-mode",
+        ]
+
+        cls.out_log = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
+            mode="w+", suffix="_smg.log", delete=False
+        )
+        cls.err_log = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
+            mode="w+", suffix="_smg_err.log", delete=False
+        )
+
+        cls.process = subprocess.Popen(
+            command,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+            text=True,
+            bufsize=1,
+        )
+
+        # Tee stdout/stderr to screen + file in background threads
+        cls._stdout_thread = threading.Thread(
+            target=_tee_output, args=(cls.process.stdout, cls.out_log), daemon=True
+        )
+        cls._stderr_thread = threading.Thread(
+            target=_tee_output, args=(cls.process.stderr, cls.err_log), daemon=True
+        )
+        cls._stdout_thread.start()
+        cls._stderr_thread.start()
+
+        # Wait for startup by polling logs (max 600s)
+        cls._wait_for_ready(timeout=600)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        if cls.process and cls.process.poll() is None:
+            kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+        for f in (cls.out_log, cls.err_log):
+            try:
+                f.close()
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        for path in (cls.out_log.name, cls.err_log.name):
+            if os.path.exists(path):
+                os.remove(path)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _read_combined_logs(cls):
+        cls.out_log.flush()
+        cls.err_log.flush()
+        cls.out_log.seek(0)
+        cls.err_log.seek(0)
+        return cls.out_log.read() + cls.err_log.read()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _wait_for_ready(cls, timeout=600, interval=5):
+        """Poll logs until all readiness markers are found."""
+        for _ in range(timeout // interval):
+            logs = cls._read_combined_logs()
+            if all(marker in logs for marker in _GRPC_READY_MARKERS):
+                print("\n[setUpClass] All gRPC readiness markers found.")
+                return
+            if cls.process.poll() is not None:
+                # Wait a moment for tee threads to flush remaining output
+                time.sleep(1)
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"Server process exited early with code {cls.process.poll()}."
+                )
+            time.sleep(interval)
+        raise TimeoutError(f"gRPC server did not become ready within {timeout}s.")
+
+    def test_smg_grpc_server_starts_and_ready(self):
+        """Verify SMG gRPC mode starts successfully and reports ready."""
+        logs = self._read_combined_logs()
+
+        # Process alive
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            self.process.poll(),
+            "Server process crashed after startup",
+        )
+
+        # Essential readiness markers present
+        for marker in _GRPC_READY_MARKERS:
+            self.assertIn(
+                marker,
+                logs,
+                f"Missing expected log marker: {marker}",
+            )
+
+    def test_smg_grpc_health_check(self):
+        """Verify the SMG gRPC server actually serves requests.
+
+        The SglangScheduler HealthCheck RPC runs a one-token generation
+        through the full pipeline (tokenizer -> scheduler -> model), so a
+        healthy response proves the gRPC server works end to end, not just
+        that it printed startup logs.
+        """
+        import grpc
+        from smg_grpc_proto import sglang_scheduler_pb2, sglang_scheduler_pb2_grpc
+
+        with grpc.insecure_channel(f"127.0.0.1:{self.grpc_port}") as channel:
+            stub = sglang_scheduler_pb2_grpc.SglangSchedulerStub(channel)
+            response = stub.HealthCheck(
+                sglang_scheduler_pb2.HealthCheckRequest(),
+                timeout=60,
+            )
+        self.assertTrue(
+            response.healthy,
+            f"SMG gRPC HealthCheck failed: {response.message}",
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""
+Test module for linear attention kernel verification and ReplaySSM feature validation on Ascend NPU.
+
+This test case launches an SGLang serving instance with specified parameters,
+and verifies that --linear-attn-verify-backend and --enable-linear-replayssm-spec
+take effect by serving real inference requests and checking characteristic log
+outputs during server startup.
+"""
+
+import os
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import QWEN3_6_35B_A3B_WEIGHTS_PATH
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(
+    est_time=400,
+    suite="full-2-npu-a3",
+    nightly=True,
+)
+
+
+class TestLinearAttentionAndReplaySSM(CustomTestCase):
+    """Testcase: Verify --linear-attn-verify-backend and --enable-linear-replayssm-spec flags.
+
+    [Test Category] Parameter
+    [Test Target] --linear-attn-verify-backend; --enable-linear-replayssm-spec
+    """
+
+    model = QWEN3_6_35B_A3B_WEIGHTS_PATH
+    OUT_LOG_PATH = "./out_log.txt"
+    ERR_LOG_PATH = "./err_log.txt"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.out_log_file = open(cls.OUT_LOG_PATH, "w+", encoding="utf-8")
+        cls.err_log_file = open(cls.ERR_LOG_PATH, "w+", encoding="utf-8")
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=[
+                "--trust-remote-code",
+                "--attention-backend",
+                "ascend",
+                "--tp-size",
+                "2",
+                "--max-running-requests",
+                "12",
+                "--mem-fraction-static",
+                "0.85",
+                "--cuda-graph-bs-decode",
+                "2",
+                "4",
+                "8",
+                "--dtype",
+                "bfloat16",
+                "--linear-attn-verify-backend",
+                "flashinfer",
+                "--enable-linear-replayssm-spec",
+            ],
+            env={
+                "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY": "1",
+                "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF": "expandable_segments:True",
+                "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE": "32",
+                "HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "1600",
+                "HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE": "AIV",
+                "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+                "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+                "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "32",
+                "SGLANG_DEEPEP_EF16_DISPATCH": "1",
+                "ENABLE_ASCEND_MOE_NZ": "1",
+            },
+            return_stdout_stderr=(cls.out_log_file, cls.err_log_file),
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        if getattr(cls, "process", None):
+            kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+        if getattr(cls, "out_log_file", None):
+            cls.out_log_file.close()
+        if getattr(cls, "err_log_file", None):
+            cls.err_log_file.close()
+        for path in (cls.OUT_LOG_PATH, cls.ERR_LOG_PATH):
+            if os.path.exists(path):
+                os.remove(path)
+
+    def _read_full_logs(self) -> str:
+        """Read the full server logs written so far."""
+        with open(self.OUT_LOG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            return f.read()
+
+    def _generate_and_check(self):
+        """Send a real inference request to prove the feature path works."""
+        response = requests.post(
+            f"{DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST}/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": "The capital of France is",
+                "sampling_params": {
+                    "temperature": 0,
+                    "max_new_tokens": 32,
+                },
+            },
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            response.status_code, 200, "The request status code is not 200."
+        )
+        self.assertIn(
+            "Paris", response.text, "The inference result does not include Paris."
+        )
+
+    def test_linear_attn_verify_backend_flashinfer(self):
+        """Verify --linear-attn-verify-backend flashinfer takes effect."""
+        self._generate_and_check()
+        logs = self._read_full_logs()
+        expected = "Linear attention kernel backend: decode=triton, prefill=triton, verify=flashinfer"
+        self.assertIn(
+            expected,
+            logs,
+            f"Expected log not found: '{expected}'\n"
+            f"Last 2000 chars of logs:\n{logs[-2000:]}",
+        )
+
+    def test_enable_linear_replayssm_spec(self):
+        """Verify --enable-linear-replayssm-spec takes effect."""
+        self._generate_and_check()
+        logs = self._read_full_logs()
+        expected = "GDN ReplaySSM ring buffers allocated"
+        self.assertIn(
+            expected,
+            logs,
+            f"Expected log not found: '{expected}'\n"
+            f"Last 2000 chars of logs:\n{logs[-2000:]}",
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Test --disaggregation-decode-extra-slots on the NPU PD disaggregation pipeline.
+
+Launches a DSV4 prefill + decode pipeline twice:
+
+1. Flag unset: the decode server auto-infers the default extra slots
+   (2x the per-worker batch, see pd_disaggregation_hook).
+2. Flag set to 64: verifies the resolved value on the running decode server,
+   that c128_state_fixed grows by the formula-derived amount, and that real
+   requests still flow through the prefill -> decode pipeline.
+"""
+
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import get_compress_state_ring_size
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_WEIGHTS_PATH
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.disaggregation_fixture import (
+    PDDisaggregationServerBase,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=600, suite="full-16-npu-a3", nightly=True)
+
+# Regex pattern to extract c128_state_fixed value from DSV4 memory pool logs
+C128_PATTERN = re.compile(r"c128_state_fixed\s*[=:]\s*([\d.]+)\s*GB")
+
+# Same process patterns as sglang.cli.killall, so the cleanup also catches
+# servers started via `sglang serve` (this test's launch method).
+_SGLANG_PROCESS_PATTERN = (
+    "sglang::|sglang.launch_server|sglang.bench|sglang.data_parallel"
+    "|sglang.srt|sglang serve"
+)
+
+# Decode server launch constants, also feeding the c128 formula below.
+TP_SIZE = 8
+DP_SIZE = 8
+MAX_RUNNING_REQUESTS = 32
+SPEC_NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS = 3
+EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS = 64
+
+
+def _cleanup_residual_sglang():
+    """Kill any leftover sglang processes before starting a new test round."""
+    print("[CLEANUP] Killing residual sglang processes...")
+    os.system(f"pkill -9 -f '{_SGLANG_PROCESS_PATTERN}' 2>/dev/null || true")
+    time.sleep(5)
+
+
+def _per_worker_max_running_requests() -> int:
+    """Per-worker request cap, as resolved by the pool configurator."""
+    return max(1, MAX_RUNNING_REQUESTS // DP_SIZE)
+
+
+def _auto_inferred_extra_slots() -> int:
+    """Extra slots the decode server infers when the flag is not set.
+
+    Mirrors pd_disaggregation_hook: with --max-running-requests set and a
+    per-worker batch of at most 32, the server reserves 2x the per-worker
+    batch as in-transfer headroom.
+    """
+    per_worker = _per_worker_max_running_requests()
+    return per_worker * 2 if per_worker <= 32 else 0
+
+
+def _expected_c128_state_rows(extra_slots: int) -> int:
+    """c128 state rows the pool configurator reserves for extra_slots.
+
+    Mirrors pool_configurator._get_c128_state_fixed_bytes (offline path):
+
+      num_req_slots = per_worker_max_running_requests + extra_slots + 1
+      state_rows = ceil_div(num_req_slots * ring_size + ring_size + 1, 128) * 128
+      c128_bytes  = state_rows * (2 * attn_head_dim) * dtype_size * num_layers
+
+    The per-row byte cost is model-specific but identical across rounds, so
+    the measured c128 growth ratio must match this row growth ratio.
+    """
+    ring_size = get_compress_state_ring_size(128, SPEC_NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS)
+    num_req_slots = _per_worker_max_running_requests() + extra_slots + 1
+    rows = num_req_slots * ring_size + ring_size + 1
+    return -(-rows // 128) * 128
+
+
+class DisaggregationExtraSlotsBase(PDDisaggregationServerBase):
+    """Base class for disaggregation extra slots validation tests.
+    Reuses the standard PD disaggregation server lifecycle and provides
+    log capture and c128_state_fixed extraction utilities.
+    """
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        cls.model = os.environ.get("MODEL_PATH", DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_WEIGHTS_PATH)
+        cls.temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        cls.transfer_backend = ["--disaggregation-transfer-backend", "ascend"]
+        cls.tp_size = int(os.environ.get("TP", str(TP_SIZE)))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        super().tearDownClass()
+        if os.path.exists(cls.temp_dir):
+            shutil.rmtree(cls.temp_dir)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _start_prefill_with_capture(cls):
+        """Launch prefill server with stdout/stderr captured to a temp log file."""
+        prefill_args = [
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "dsv4",
+            "--trust-remote-code",
+            "--disaggregation-mode",
+            "prefill",
+            "--tp-size",
+            str(cls.tp_size),
+            "--dtype",
+            "bfloat16",
+            "--disable-radix-cache",
+            "--disable-cuda-graph",
+            "--page-size",
+            "128",
+            "--dp-size",
+            str(cls.tp_size),
+            "--enable-dp-attention",
+            "--device",
+            "npu",
+            "--watchdog-timeout",
+            "9000",
+            "--chunked-prefill-size",
+            "-1",
+            "--max-running-requests",
+            "128",
+            "--moe-a2a-backend",
+            "deepep",
+            "--deepep-mode",
+            "auto",
+            "--quantization",
+            "modelslim",
+            "--enable-dp-lm-head",
+            "--kv-cache-dtype",
+            "auto",
+            "--skip-server-warmup",
+            "--disaggregation-transfer-backend",
+            "ascend",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.8",
+            "--prefill-max-requests",
+            "1",
+            "--disable-overlap-schedule",
+            "--disaggregation-bootstrap-port",
+            "8998",
+        ]
+        prefill_args += cls.transfer_backend
+
+        env = {
+            **os.environ,
+            "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+            "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+            "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF": "expandable_segments:True",
+            "HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "2000",
+            "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY": "1",
+            "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL": "tcp://127.0.0.1:24667",
+            "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE": "32",
+            "INF_NAN_MODE_FORCE_DISABLE": "1",
+            "HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE": "AIV",

+    def _extract_c128(self, log_path, max_wait=60):
+        """Poll the log file and extract the c128_state_fixed value in GB."""
+        for i in range(max_wait):
+            try:
+                with open(log_path, "r") as f:
+                    content = f.read()
+                matches = C128_PATTERN.findall(content)
+                if matches:
+                    val = float(matches[-1])
+                    print(f"  [EXTRACT] c128_state_fixed = {val} GB")
+                    return val
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            time.sleep(1)
+
+        print(f"[WARN] c128_state_fixed not found in {log_path}, last 30 lines:")
+        self._tail_log(log_path, 30)
+        return None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tail_log(log_path, n=30):
+        """Print the last n lines of a log file for debugging."""
+        try:
+            with open(log_path, "r") as f:
+                lines = f.readlines()
+            for line in lines[-n:]:
+                print("    LOG> " + line.rstrip())
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"    Could not read log: {e}")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _kill_gracefully(proc):
+        """Terminate a process gracefully, falling back to kill if needed."""
+        if proc and proc.poll() is None:
+            proc.terminate()
+            try:
+                proc.wait(timeout=30)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                proc.kill()
+                proc.wait()
+
+    def _cleanup_round(self):
+        """Terminate server processes and release resources between test rounds."""
+        print("[CLEANUP] Terminating decode and prefill...")
+        if getattr(self, "process_lb", None):
+            try:
+                kill_process_tree(self.process_lb.pid, wait_timeout=60)
+            except Exception as e:
+                print(f"[CLEANUP] Error killing lb: {e}")
+            self.process_lb = None
+        self._kill_gracefully(getattr(self, "process_decode", None))
+        self._kill_gracefully(getattr(self, "process_prefill", None))
+
+        for attr in ["_prefill_stdout", "_decode_stdout"]:
+            if hasattr(self, attr):
+                try:
+                    getattr(self, attr).close()
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+
+        print("[CLEANUP] Sleeping 10s for NPU resource release...")
+        time.sleep(10)
+
+    def _run_round(self, extra_slots):
+        """Run a full test round: start servers, wait for ready, extract c128 value."""
+        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
+        print(f"ROUND: extra_slots={extra_slots}")
+        print(f"{'=' * 60}")
+
+        _cleanup_residual_sglang()
+        self._start_prefill_with_capture()
+        self._start_decode_with_capture(extra_slots)
+
+        print("[WAIT] Waiting for prefill /health...")
+        self.wait_server_ready(self.prefill_url + "/health")
+        print("[WAIT] Waiting for decode /health...")
+        self.wait_server_ready(self.decode_url + "/health")
+
+        print("[WAIT] Services ready, sleeping 10s for memory calc log...")
+        time.sleep(10)
+
+        val = self._extract_c128(self._decode_stdout_name)
+        return val
+
+    def _verify_extra_slots_in_use(self, expected_slots):
+        """The running decode server must expose the resolved extra slots."""
+        info = requests.get(self.decode_url + "/server_info", timeout=30).json()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            info.get("disaggregation_decode_extra_slots"),
+            expected_slots,
+            f"decode server resolved disaggregation_decode_extra_slots="
+            f"{info.get('disaggregation_decode_extra_slots')}, "
+            f"expected {expected_slots}",
+        )
+
+    def _verify_serving_through_pd_pipeline(self):
+        """Serve real requests through the pipeline with the extra slots active.
+
+        Each request transits the in-transfer state on the decode side, so a
+        successful completion proves the parameterized request-slot pool
+        actually serves traffic, not just that memory accounting changed.
+        """
+        self.launch_lb()
+        try:
+            for i in range(4):
+                response = requests.post(
+                    f"{self.lb_url}/generate",
+                    json={
+                        "text": "The capital of France is",
+                        "sampling_params": {
+                            "temperature": 0,
+                            "max_new_tokens": 32,
+                        },
+                    },
+                    timeout=120,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    response.status_code,
+                    200,
+                    f"Request {i} failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}",
+                )
+                data = response.json()
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    isinstance(data["text"], str) and data["text"].strip(),
+                    f"Request {i} returned an empty completion.",
+                )
+                self.assertIn(
+                    data["meta_info"]["finish_reason"]["type"],
+                    ("stop", "length"),
+                    f"Request {i} finished abnormally.",
+                )
+        finally:
+            if self.process_lb:
+                try:
+                    kill_process_tree(self.process_lb.pid, wait_timeout=60)
+                except Exception as e:
+                    print(f"[CLEANUP] Error killing lb: {e}")
+                self.process_lb = None
+
+
+class TestDisaggregationDecodeExtraSlots(DisaggregationExtraSlotsBase):
+    """Testcase: --disaggregation-decode-extra-slots sizes the decode c128 state pool.
+
+    [Test Category] Parameter
+    [Test Target] --disaggregation-decode-extra-slots
+    """
+
+    def test_c128_matches_formula_with_extra_slots(self):
+        """Verify c128_state_fixed follows the sizing formula for extra slots."""
+
+        # Round 1: flag not set. The decode server auto-infers the default
+        # extra slots (2x the per-worker batch) instead of using zero.
+        c128_default = self._run_round(extra_slots=None)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(
+            c128_default,
+            "Failed to capture c128_state_fixed with auto-inferred "
+            "--disaggregation-decode-extra-slots",
+        )
+        self.assertGreater(
+            c128_default,
+            0,
+            "c128_state_fixed should be positive for the DSV4 decode pool",
+        )
+        print(
+            f"[RESULT] Auto-inferred extra_slots="
+            f"{_auto_inferred_extra_slots()}: c128_state_fixed = {c128_default} GB"
+        )
+
+        self._cleanup_round()
+
+        # Round 2: explicit extra_slots=64
+        c128_explicit = self._run_round(extra_slots=EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(
+            c128_explicit,
+            "Failed to capture c128_state_fixed with "
+            f"--disaggregation-decode-extra-slots={EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS}",
+        )
+        print(
+            f"[RESULT] With extra_slots={EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS}: "
+            f"c128_state_fixed = {c128_explicit} GB"
+        )
+
+        # The parameter is actually in force and usable on the running server.
+        self._verify_extra_slots_in_use(EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS)
+        self._verify_serving_through_pd_pipeline()
+
+        self._cleanup_round()
+
+        # Formula-derived expectation (see _expected_c128_state_rows): the
+        # per-row byte cost is model-specific but identical across rounds, so
+        # the growth must match the row-growth ratio exactly, up to the
+        # 0.01 GB log rounding.
+        rows_default = _expected_c128_state_rows(_auto_inferred_extra_slots())
+        rows_explicit = _expected_c128_state_rows(EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS)
+        expected_c128_explicit = c128_default * rows_explicit / rows_default
+        tolerance_gb = max(0.1, 0.05 * expected_c128_explicit)
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(
+            c128_explicit,
+            expected_c128_explicit,
+            delta=tolerance_gb,
+            msg=(
+                f"c128_state_fixed with extra_slots={EXPLICIT_EXTRA_SLOTS} "
+                f"({c128_explicit} GB) should be ~{expected_c128_explicit:.2f} GB, "
+                f"derived from {c128_default} GB x {rows_explicit}/{rows_default} "
+                f"rows (per-worker max_running_requests="
+                f"{_per_worker_max_running_requests()})"
+            ),
+        )
+        print("[PASS] Test completed successfully!")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+            "DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT": "1",
+            "USE_NPU_MOE_GATING_TOP_K": "1",
+            "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "64",
+            "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND": "16",
+            "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS": "2048",
+            "DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ": "1",

+            "SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_HC_PRENORM": "False",
+            "SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_POST": "False",

+        ]
+        print(f"[DECODE] command={' '.join(command)}")
+
+        cls._decode_stdout = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(

+        )

+        cls.process_decode = subprocess.Popen(
+            command,

+            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+            text=True,
+            bufsize=1,
+            env=env,
+        )

+        for i in range(max_wait):
+            try:
+                with open(log_path, "r") as f:
+                    content = f.read()
+                matches = C128_PATTERN.findall(content)
+                if matches:
+                    val = float(matches[-1])
+                    print(f"  [EXTRACT] c128_state_fixed = {val} GB")
+                    return val
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            time.sleep(1)
+
+        print(f"[WARN] c128_state_fixed not found in {log_path}, last 30 lines:")
+        self._tail_log(log_path, 30)
+        return None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tail_log(log_path, n=30):
+        """Print the last n lines of a log file for debugging."""
+        try:
+            with open(log_path, "r") as f:
+                lines = f.readlines()
+            for line in lines[-n:]:
+                print("    LOG> " + line.rstrip())
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"    Could not read log: {e}")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _kill_gracefully(proc):
+        """Terminate a process gracefully, falling back to kill if needed."""
+        if proc and proc.poll() is None:
+            proc.terminate()
+            try:
+                proc.wait(timeout=30)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                proc.kill()
+                proc.wait()
+
+    def _cleanup_round(self):
+        """Terminate server processes and release resources between test rounds."""
+        print("[CLEANUP] Terminating decode and prefill...")
+        self._kill_gracefully(getattr(self, "process_decode", None))
+        self._kill_gracefully(getattr(self, "process_prefill", None))
+
+        for attr in ["_prefill_stdout", "_decode_stdout"]:
+            if hasattr(self, attr):
+                try:
+                    getattr(self, attr).close()
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+
+        print("[CLEANUP] Sleeping 10s for NPU resource release...")
+        time.sleep(10)
+
+    def _run_round(self, extra_slots):
+        """Run a full test round: start servers, wait for ready, extract c128 value."""
+        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
+        print(f"ROUND: extra_slots={extra_slots}")
+        print(f"{'=' * 60}")
+
+        _cleanup_residual_sglang()
+        self._start_prefill_with_capture()
+        self._start_decode_with_capture(extra_slots)
+
+        print("[WAIT] Waiting for prefill /health...")
+        self.wait_server_ready(self.prefill_url + "/health")
+        print("[WAIT] Waiting for decode /health...")
+        self.wait_server_ready(self.decode_url + "/health")
+
+        print("[WAIT] Services ready, sleeping 10s for memory calc log...")
+        time.sleep(10)
+
+        val = self._extract_c128(self._decode_stdout_name)
+        return val
